finite_sample_note: Day17's 90/95/97.5% intervals were identical because n_cal=10 forces all those split-conformal quantiles to the maximum calibration residual.
purpose: Quantify interval stability, empirical coverage, false-safe rate, and decisiveness as the target calibration set grows while keeping the adaptation set fixed at 10 cells.
scope_note: This is a sensitivity analysis. Larger calibration sets increase label burden and reduce the remaining test cohort; results must not be used as deployment policy selection without independent validation.
